title: Tukar demo
note: One source of truth. vo.py speaks `vo`, capture.mjs runs `id` against the real app, Remotion lays the capture into the kraft world and burns `captions`. Scene length follows the narration; if the real capture ran longer (a proof, a ledger wait) the composition speeds that clip up and says by how much on screen.

scenes.vo: This is Tukar. A private way to send money home on Stellar, live on testnet today. Dollars in one end, local currency out the other.
captions: This is Tukar. A private way to send money home on Stellar, live on testnet today.
Dollars in one end, local currency out the other.

scenes.vo: Here is the sender. One tap connects a real testnet key, no seed phrase. Two hundred dollars to Mexico. The panel beside it reads the corridor's cap and its required disclosure from an on-chain policy registry, and prices the send against eight real remittance providers.
captions: Here is the sender. One tap connects a real testnet key, no seed phrase.
Two hundred dollars to Mexico.
The panel beside it reads the corridor's cap and its required disclosure from an on-chain policy registry,
and prices the send against eight real remittance providers.

scenes.vo: Sending builds the compliance proof on the device. It shows the sender is allow-listed and not sanctioned, and it is bound to their key, so nobody else can reuse it. It takes about thirty seconds for real, so this clip runs fast.
captions: Sending builds the compliance proof on the device.
It shows the sender is allow-listed and not sanctioned,
and it is bound to their key, so nobody else can reuse it.
It takes about thirty seconds for real, so this clip runs fast.

scenes.vo: Then real testnet USDC moves into the shielded pool and the note is registered in the Merkle tree. Out comes a bearer claim note: a string, a QR, or a claim link you can wrap in a PIN. An auditor gets a view-only copy that cannot spend.
captions: Then real testnet USDC moves into the shielded pool and the note is registered in the Merkle tree.
Out comes a bearer claim note: a string, a QR, or a claim link you can wrap in a PIN.
An auditor gets a view-only copy that cannot spend.

scenes.vo: Back home the recipient pastes the note. The app rebuilds the tree from chain, and the payment is there.
captions: Back home the recipient pastes the note.
The app rebuilds the tree from chain, and the payment is there.

scenes.vo: The local figure is read on-chain from the pool's Reflector quote, at the median of five records. That is the same basis the settlement gate enforces, so a bad price fails closed instead of quietly costing the receiver money.
captions: The local figure is read on-chain from the pool's Reflector quote, at the median of five records.
That is the same basis the settlement gate enforces,
so a bad price fails closed instead of quietly costing the receiver money.

scenes.vo: Cash out goes through an anchor. A real SEP-38 quote from the reference testnet anchor, and the app says plainly what that anchor will and will not do. Withdrawing spends the note's nullifier on-chain, which releases the tokens and blocks a second spend.
captions: Cash out goes through an anchor. A real SEP-38 quote from the reference testnet anchor,
and the app says plainly what that anchor will and will not do.
Withdrawing spends the note's nullifier on-chain,
which releases the tokens and blocks a second spend.

scenes.vo: Now the part that makes this compliant and not only private. Prove the exact amount, or that it is under a figure, or inside a band, or that a set of payments sums under a cap. Nothing else is revealed.
captions: Now the part that makes this compliant and not only private.
Prove the exact amount, or that it is under a figure, or inside a band,
or that a set of payments sums under a cap. Nothing else is revealed.

scenes.vo: The regulator pastes that receipt. It is checked twice, in the browser and by the live Stellar verifier contract. Valid, and bound to a real on-chain deposit.
captions: The regulator pastes that receipt.
It is checked twice, in the browser and by the live Stellar verifier contract.
Valid, and bound to a real on-chain deposit.

scenes.vo: Change one character. It is rejected on-chain and nothing is disclosed. There is a third verdict too, for a proof that is cryptographically valid but not tied to real state.
captions: Change one character.
It is rejected on-chain and nothing is disclosed.
There is a third verdict too, for a proof that is cryptographically valid but not tied to real state.

scenes.vo: The same console imports a view-only note, registers an audit request a disclosure has to answer, runs a real Travel Rule exchange over signed TRP, and exports a compliance pack for three jurisdictions.
captions: The same console imports a view-only note,
registers an audit request a disclosure has to answer,
runs a real Travel Rule exchange over signed TRP,
and exports a compliance pack for three jurisdictions.

scenes.vo: The operator console reads everything from chain. Pool health and custody, a reserves attestation setting declared liabilities against the USDC actually held, per-corridor policy, oracle health, monitoring, and every contract by ID.
captions: The operator console reads everything from chain.
Pool health and custody, a reserves attestation setting declared liabilities against the USDC actually held,
per-corridor policy, oracle health, monitoring, and every contract by ID.

scenes.vo: Anyone can check a receipt on the public verify page, no wallet, no account. The documentation ships with the app.
captions: Anyone can check a receipt on the public verify page, no wallet, no account.
The documentation ships with the app.

scenes.vo: This is Stellar testnet, it is not audited, and the fiat edges run against a reference anchor. Everything in between is real. Private in the middle, accountable at the edges.
captions: This is Stellar testnet, it is not audited, and the fiat edges run against a reference anchor.
Everything in between is real.
Private in the middle, accountable at the edges.
